title: DTRC/DARPA SUBOFF (Groves-Huang-Chang 1989; Liu-Huang 1998) tow-tank resistance anchor, registered per point

status_meaning.TRANSCRIBED: every value is a verbatim transcription of a table archived in this repo; no primary document was re-read here
status_meaning.VERIFIED: values re-read from the primary document and matched
status_meaning.OBTAINED: primary document stored in-repo with sha256

grade_scale.A: primary document verified in this environment (page/PDF read, primary doc sha256 registered)
grade_scale.B: transcription + verbatim quote + source-document sha256 (source hashed, not re-read)
grade_scale.C: second-hand transcription: neither the primary document nor a hashed source document is available in this environment

environment.note: the sandbox has no network; primary-document acquisition is impossible here, which is why the ceiling grade is C

primary_documents.citation: P. E. Groves, T. T. Huang, S. S. Chang (1989). Geometric Characteristics of DARPA SUBOFF Models. DTRC Report SHD-1298-01.
primary_documents.role: hull geometry / offset tables (L_max, D_max, wetted area)
primary_documents.what_is_missing: the primary geometry report itself (offset tables + Table 1 principal particulars) and its sha256

primary_documents.citation: H.-L. Liu, T. T. Huang (1998). Summary of DARPA Suboff Experimental Program Data. CRDKNSWC/HD-1298-11 (DTIC ADA359226).
primary_documents.what_is_missing: the primary report PDF (Table 14, report p.23) and its sha256 — the two in-repo transcriptions disagree by ~17%, so the primary is the only thing that can adjudicate

machine_cross_source.note: markdown transcription and machine lock parse to the same (V, R_T) pairs to 5e-4 m/s / 5e-3 N

cross_family_conflict.statement: the two in-repo transcriptions of the same DTRC tow-tank table differ by a nearly constant factor ~1.17 across all overlapping speeds; they cannot both be Table 14 AFF-1 bare-hull values as recorded

sixth_point_check.S1_derived_source: benchmarks/pending/suboff_highre_resistance/refs_lock.json:/derived_6th[0] (back-derived from the Flow360 DDES error table — NOT an S1 table row)

cross_family_conflict.resolution_requires: primary CRDKNSWC/HD-1298-11 Table 14 (p.23); offline this stays WITHHELD

hypotheses_ranked.statement: one of the two transcriptions is not the AFF-1 bare-hull row (wrong configuration column, e.g. a with-appendages or a different model-scale row)
hypotheses_ranked.supporting: the offset is a pure multiplicative constant 1.170 independent of speed (sd 0.0021); appendages alone explain only ~2.6% (in-repo appendage share), so a column mix-up rather than a physics difference is the better fit
hypotheses_ranked.test: read Table 14 page 23 and match both the speed list and the R_T list; also compare against Table 15/16 configuration rows

hypotheses_ranked.statement: one family was normalised at a different density or reference scale before being tabulated
hypotheses_ranked.supporting: rho band 997-1000 gives only 0.3% and a model-scale change scales as L^2 (factor 4 or 0.25), so neither closes 1.17 cleanly
hypotheses_ranked.test: check the primary for a reference-temperature / density footnote; both families would then need a re-derivation

hypotheses_ranked.statement: the 6-significant-digit transcription pair is right and the third-party paper rescaled EFD to a different reference area for its C_T comparison
hypotheses_ranked.supporting: S1's Table 3 is titled 'resistance in comparison with EFD' and may tabulate a rescaled force; but the in-repo S1 transcription is dimensional N, not a coefficient
hypotheses_ranked.test: compare S1 Table 3 numbers with the paper's own CFD column and with its stated reference area

criteria.statement: >=3 numerical anchor points, each with verbatim quote + locator + recomputable sha256 of the quoted archive
independent ITTC-1957 recomputation agrees with every registered C_F to <= 1e-9 absolute
the two in-repo transcription families agree within the 15% drag gate
criteria.consequence: an anchor-to-simulation deviation below 15% cannot be adjudicated from these two families until the primary is acquired; the census reports the deviation against BOTH families

criteria.statement: Cb / L-over-D / wetted area validated before the drag anchor is used
evidence grade assigned as-is: A needs a read primary, B needs a hashed source document
criteria.note: all points grade C by construction in this environment; a higher grade is REFUSED, not unavailable

summary.blocking_issue: cross-family conflict 17% > 15% gate (criterion C3); primary report needed

claim_boundary.may_be_cited_as: per-point transcription register of CRDKNSWC/HD-1298-11 Table 14 recovered from two in-repo transcription families that disagree by ~17%
claim_boundary.consequence: no simulation-to-anchor agreement claim above 'agrees with a second-hand transcription, and only within the family spread' is admissible
